runId.description: Run whose event log the records come from.

state.description: complete: every record of the run's event log up to the source high-water mark was readable; partial: at least one record before the run's terminal could not be read, so a final may be missing.

count.description: Number of final-message records after the header line.

throughEventSeq.description: Inclusive seq of the last readable run event read before the run's first terminal; 0 when the checked log held no readable event.

FinalMessagesHeader.description: Header line of final/final-messages.jsonl (UTF-8, every line LF-terminated). Each following line is one complete run event exactly as the run's event log serializes it: a harness message its adapter typed final, neither a fragment nor a buffered snapshot, in event order with its own attempt, session and native identity.
